boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations along Gambier’s village-center streets and nearby recreation corridors, each paired with one directly sourced reason to go.

cards.title: Start with the bookstore’s shelves
cards.subtitle: Gaskin Avenue — Kenyon College Bookstore
cards.notes: Walk Gaskin Avenue to browse the bookstore at 106 Gaskin Ave., a documented hub of Gambier’s academic and literary life.
cards.short_summary: A literary stop anchors this central village block.
cards.evidence_claim: Kenyon identifies the Kenyon College Bookstore at 106 Gaskin Avenue and describes it as an important hub in the college’s academic and literary life.
cards.access_notes: Public retail destination; merchandise purchases require payment.

cards.title: Pause for a deli meal
cards.subtitle: Gaskin Avenue — Gambier Deli
cards.notes: Continue along Gaskin Avenue to 110 Gaskin Ave.; check the deli’s official menu before choosing breakfast or lunch.
cards.short_summary: A daytime deli gives the corridor a practical meal stop.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gambier Deli’s official site lists its location as 110 Gaskin Avenue and publishes a food menu and regular daytime hours.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists regular hours Tuesday–Friday, 8 a.m.–2 p.m., and Saturday, 8 a.m.–3 p.m.; verify before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Birds of a Feather Bake Shop and Boutique
cards.title: Find baked goods and local gifts
cards.subtitle: Gaskin Avenue — Birds of a Feather Bake Shop and Boutique
cards.notes: Look for Birds of a Feather at 114 Gaskin Ave.; its documented mix of baked goods and local gifts gives this block one clear purpose.
cards.short_summary: Bakery cases and locally made gifts share one village storefront.
cards.evidence_claim: Kenyon lists Birds of a Feather at 114 Gaskin Avenue and says it offers fresh-baked goods, local gifts and themed care packages.
cards.access_notes: Public bakery and boutique; purchases require payment.

cards.title: Book a personal-care appointment
cards.subtitle: Gaskin Avenue — Marlow Salon Spa
cards.notes: Use the 112 Gaskin Ave. block for a planned salon visit; contact Marlow first to confirm service availability and an appointment.
cards.short_summary: A named salon adds an appointment-based errand to Gaskin Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Kenyon lists Marlow Salon Spa at 112 Gaskin Avenue and documents hair, nail and massage services.
cards.access_notes: Contact the business to confirm appointments, services and current availability.

cards.title: Take a coffee-and-food break
cards.subtitle: Wiggin Street — Wiggin Street Coffee
cards.notes: Turn onto East Wiggin Street for the named coffee shop and eatery at number 101; check current service details before heading over.
cards.short_summary: The corridor’s reason is a clearly identified café stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Kenyon lists Wiggin Street Coffee at 101 E. Wiggin Street and identifies it as a coffee shop and eatery in Gambier.
cards.access_notes: Public coffee shop and eatery; confirm current hours directly before visiting.

cards.title: Browse a village clothing boutique
cards.subtitle: Scott Lane — The Weather Vane
cards.notes: Step behind the Kenyon Inn to 103 Scott Lane and browse The Weather Vane; verify opening details before making a special trip.
cards.short_summary: A tucked-back lane leads to a named clothing boutique.
cards.evidence_claim: Kenyon lists The Weather Vane at 103 Scott Lane and identifies it as a clothing boutique behind the Kenyon Inn.
cards.access_notes: Public clothing boutique; confirm current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Make a village grocery run
cards.subtitle: Chase Avenue — Village Market
cards.notes: Follow Chase Avenue to Village Market at number 111 for groceries; bring payment and verify current hours before planning the errand.
cards.short_summary: The village-center corridor handles everyday grocery needs.
cards.evidence_claim: Kenyon’s current employee guide identifies Village Market as a grocery destination at 111 Chase Avenue in Gambier.
cards.access_notes: Public grocery market; verify current operating hours before visiting.

cards.title: See a longstanding community hub
cards.subtitle: Chase Avenue — Gambier Post Office
cards.notes: Walk the Chase Avenue village-center block to the Gambier Post Office and notice the civic role documented by the Postal Service.
cards.short_summary: Postal history supplies this block’s town-and-gown connection.
cards.evidence_claim: The U.S. Postal Service documents the Gambier Post Office as a community hub where town and college have mixed for decades.
cards.access_notes: Exterior viewing is generally possible from the public corridor; verify USPS service hours separately for counter access.

cards.title: Choose a community recreation stop
cards.subtitle: Meadow Lane — Gambier Community Center
cards.notes: Head down Meadow Lane to number 115 for the playground, fields or picnic facilities; check village notices before organized use.
cards.short_summary: Public recreation facilities make Meadow Lane worth the detour.
cards.evidence_claim: The Village of Gambier states that the Community Center at 115 Meadow Lane provides a playground, athletic fields and picnic facilities.
cards.access_notes: The village describes public recreation amenities; confirm open hours and reservation requirements before organized activities.

cards.entity_name: Brown Family Environmental Center Resource Center
cards.title: Reach a network of nature trails
cards.subtitle: Laymon Road — Brown Family Environmental Center Resource Center
cards.notes: Follow Laymon Road to the BFEC Resource Center, then use Kenyon’s current facility map to select a marked trail suited to your group.
cards.short_summary: A mapped trail network rewards the longer trip beyond the village core.
cards.evidence_claim: Kenyon’s BFEC facility map places the Resource Center on Laymon Road and documents named trails including Prairie, River and Nature Play trails.
cards.source_title: Brown Family Environmental Center Facility and Trail Map
cards.access_notes: Consult the official map, posted signs and current BFEC notices; trail difficulty and seasonal conditions vary.
